notes.title: Nominated for the Steam Awards! 🏆
notes.content:
Hello VR Detailers! 👋

We are thrilled to announce that our game has been nominated for the prestigious VR Game of the Year category in this year's Steam Awards! 🎉

This nomination means a lot to us, as it celebrates games that have been continuously supported and improved over time. We couldn't have achieved this without the incredible support from our community. Thank you for being with us on this journey!

If you think Car Detailing Simulator VR deserves this award, you can vote for us! 😊 Let's make this happen together! 💪

notes.title: VR Version Released!!! 🥳
notes.content:
Car Detailing Simulator VR 👓 is out on Steam!

Conduct all the amazing detailing transformations in the immersive VR environment. 🤯

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527890/Car_Detailing_Simulator_VR/

Already have a Car Detailing Simulator on Steam? 👀 Get an extra 10% off when you buy the VR version in a bundle! 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43528/Detailing_in_Virtual_Reality/

[previewyoutube=MW4S8zu30zo;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy working on cars and complete the tasks with style! 🏎️

Key Features of the Virtual Reality Adventure 👓

*Three types of treatments (basic, internal, and external)
*Each tool has some form of ammunition for its operation
*Various degrees of dirtiness
*A set of tools and accessories to work with
*Modern garage equipped with a lift, rack, etc.
*Take on new orders and earn money
*Ten old-school classic and modern cars to work on

The brand new VR detailing adventure is right here! PLAY NOW! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/2d756892db2e4818983f27bd09f3c054250ffaf9.png 

See you around,
CDS VR Team

notes.title: Release Date Set!
notes.content:
Attention Detailers! 📣

We are excited to announce that the VR version 🕶️ of the Car Detailing Simulator is launching on September 26, 2024, at 3:00 PM CEST! 🥳

Don't miss the premiere and add it to your Wishlist! ✅ 👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2527890/Car_Detailing_Simulator_VR/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/11eb80a02d6f47fee6f3f7d1b10d0cf185c18225.png 

In Car Detailing Simulator VR, you can renew and restore cars to their former glory, catering to the demands of your discerning customers. Transform neglected vehicles into stunning and well-maintained machines that can be the envy of all. 🚗

Get ready to dive into the immersive car detailing world and experience the satisfaction of bringing life back to every car you touch. Mark your calendars and prepare for the ultimate VR detailing experience on September 26, 2024, at 3:00 PM CEST!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38917699/2d756892db2e4818983f27bd09f3c054250ffaf9.png 

Regards,
CDR VR Team
